messages.author: cc8d7fb5f7030998
messages.subject: Re: Live data fetching and visualisation with Shiny
parts:
Hi Juan,

Can you elaborate on what you mean by "live data"?

For instance if you just want to maintain up-to-date data, there is nothing keeping you from having a cron job that continually updates your data file on the server. Or alternatively, you could have your script pull the data from somewhere using RCurl (http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/RCurl/index.html). 

When I think of "live" data, I think of online APIs that serve data in some format like JSON. If that is what you are thinking, you could pull it down using RCurl and then load it as an R object using RJSONIO (http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/RJSONIO/index.html).

On the other hand, if by "live" you mean user-supplied data, this gallery entry provides an example of doing that: http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/upload-file.html.

Keith
